text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Oof, these kinds of games are really tough 
after all, huh?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
It's fine, honestly. The fact that it's 
hard to get is what makes it fun.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Besides, you know, while we were doing it, 
it was thrilling and fun, right? That's 
what matters most!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
"Come on, that's enough moping around! 
Let's go grab something tasty with 
Palmer!"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: It ended in a disappointing result...
